claims.statement: NPS Vatsalya to widen NPS coverage to ~40 crore minors

PAT margin was 9.8% vs 13.8% YoY due to Rs 11 crore provision for doubtful debts; adjusted PAT margin improved to 14.9% (+76 bps YoY).
13 state governments are in POC stage for Agristack data exchange enabling lending, insurance, advisory use cases.
International business engaged with 12 countries across 18 active opportunities with 2 bids shortlisted.
Company invests in people, products, technology and centers of excellence in open source/open standards tech stacks.
Union Budget 2024-25 focused on making NPS a more inclusive lifecycle instrument promoting savings from an early stage
Aspiration for new businesses to contribute 25% of top line in next two to three years

New businesses currently 2-5% of revenue, positive operating margin expected once significant uptake
